ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: The visible ventral surface on the right lobe exhibits a high contrast ratio with approximately 65% high-intensity white/cream pixels and 35% low-intensity dark grey/black pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white block occupying the distal and outer regions of the right lobe; a primary dark-intensity mass is concentrated at the fluke base and along the medial margin; a distinctive tan/yellowish high-chroma circular patch is situated in the upper-central region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a sharp vertex and deep penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely high irregularity; the right lobe inner trailing edge contains a significant concave indentation (missing tissue) followed by high-frequency, sharp serrations toward the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Right lobe follows a broad convex curve on the leading edge transitioning to an irregular, jagged trailing margin; left lobe appears elongated and steeply angled.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-intensity white circular objects (barnacles) are concentrated along the leading edges and distal tips of both lobes; scattered white circular scars are present on the dark pigmented regions near the fluke base.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, dark linear pixel disruptions are visible crossing the white field of the right lobe, oriented vertically towards the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major structural irregularity on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe indicating significant past trauma or tissue loss; heavy barnacle colonization along the dorsal leading edges.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent yellowish-tan focal discoloration patch located on the medial white region of the right fluke lobe.
